subtitle: Bala okubonakalayo
short_description: Shaya amasikwele ukuze inombolo ngayinye ibone amhlophe afanayo nayo.
description:
Shaya amasikwele amnyama ukuze amasikwele amnyama angaxhumani ngomphetho, futhi wonke amasikwele amhlophe ahlale exhunyiwe. Inombolo ngayinye ibala amasikwele amhlophe ayibonayo emugqeni nasekholomini wayo, kuhlanganise nelayo, futhi kumelwe ilingane nenombolo yayo.

Thepha isikwele esingenalutho ukuze ujikeleze phakathi kwamnyama, amhlophe, nongaziwa. Izinombolo ezikhonjiwe zihlala zisendaweni, futhi umbhalo ekuskrini ukutshela ukuthi yiziphi izindlela zokubona noma ukuxhumana ezephula imithetho.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
